user_goal.text: Approve all venmo payment requests from my roommates from this calendar month.

decisive_artifacts.question: Does the retained evaluator result show that every expected updated payment request has a non-null approved_at value?

decisive_artifacts.artifact: Retained per-record venmo.PaymentRequest changed-field sets and official evaluator result
decisive_artifacts.question: Does the retained evaluator result show that approved_at is the only changed field for every updated payment request?

decisive_artifacts.artifact: Retained added, updated, and removed venmo.PaymentRequest record diff and official evaluator result
decisive_artifacts.question: Does the retained evaluator result show that no payment requests were added or removed?
